Package com.saicone.types.parser

Class AllocParser<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.AllocParser<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type result of the allocatable size structure.
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeParser<T>, Function<Object,T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArrayParser, BitSetParser, CollectionParser, MapParser
public abstract class AllocParser<T> extends Object implements TypeParser<T>
Represents a parser that convert objects into an allocatable size object.
